categories.main_business_segments: Guizhou Aviation Technical Development Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of aerospace difficult-to-deform metal ring forgings, mainly for aircraft engines. Its products also serve aerospace rocket engines, missiles, marine gas turbines, industrial gas turbines, and other high-end equipment sectors. The company focuses on aviation engine ring forgings, gas turbine forgings, aerospace forgings, and other high-end equipment forgings.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed proprietary core technologies including material deformation and microstructure control, low plasticity material surface control, intelligent numerical simulation for process design and optimization, and precise stable rolling of complex thin-walled ring forgings. It employs advanced ring rolling and forging techniques for difficult-to-deform materials such as high-temperature alloys and titanium alloys. The production process integrates digital twin technology, AI optimization, and intelligent manufacturing systems to enhance quality, reduce costs, and shorten production cycles.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major domestic aerospace groups such as China Aviation Engine Group and AVIC, as well as international aerospace giants like GE Aviation, Pratt & Whitney, Safran, Rolls-Royce, and Honeywell. The company serves the commercial aircraft engine market, aerospace rocket engine sector, gas turbine industry, nuclear power, hydrogen energy, and deep-sea equipment markets. Its products are used in both domestic and international aerospace and energy sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Guiyang, Guizhou Province, and production facilities in Sichuan and other regions. It has a significant international presence serving global aerospace manufacturers, with overseas subsidiaries and customers in the United States, Hong Kong, and other countries. Overseas business accounted for 45.24% of revenue in 2024, showing strong growth in international markets including Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Guizhou Aviation Technical Development Co., Ltd. operates mainly in the midstream segment of the aerospace supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of high-precision ring forgings for aircraft engines and other high-end equipment. It sources raw materials primarily from designated suppliers specified by its customers and supplies critical components directly to aerospace engine manufacturers and system integrators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technological innovation and R&D investment, focusing on advanced materials, near-net-shape forming technologies, digital process simulation, and intelligent manufacturing. It pursues a 'dual-drive' strategy targeting both domestic and international markets, expanding product applications into emerging sectors like nuclear power, hydrogen energy, and deep-sea equipment. R&D projects include integrated ring design and rolling control, quality stability, new material forging processes, and composite billet technologies, aiming to maintain domestic leadership and enhance global competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized aerospace ring forgings and related components to domestic and international aerospace engine manufacturers and other high-end equipment producers. The company operates on a 'make-to-order' production model, with long-term supply agreements and strategic contracts with key customers. It also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic aerospace ring forging manufacturer with significant market share in China and growing presence internationally. It competes with established global aerospace forging suppliers such as Carlton Forge Works, Doncasters Group, and Howmet Aerospace. While these competitors have integrated full aerospace supply chains, Guizhou Aviation focuses on high-quality ring forgings and has secured strategic partnerships with major global engine manufacturers, positioning itself as a key supplier in the Asia-Pacific region.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.805 billion, a 14.19% decrease from the previous year, mainly due to domestic customer delivery adjustments. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 188.6 million, a slight increase of 1.63%. Total assets grew by 25.75% to RMB 4.29 billion, supported by convertible bond issuance and new project investments. The company maintains stable cash flow and continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D, reflecting a steady growth trajectory despite market challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers high-precision, high-performance aerospace ring forgings made from difficult-to-deform metal materials, leveraging proprietary technologies that ensure superior material uniformity, dimensional accuracy, and process stability. Its integrated digital and intelligent manufacturing capabilities enable cost-effective, short-cycle production with consistent quality. Strategic partnerships with leading global aerospace engine manufacturers and certifications such as NADCAP and AS9100D underscore its reliability and competitive advantage in both domestic and international markets.
